lines.zh: 横着走不是毛病，是我最省力的方向。
lines.en: Walking sideways is not a flaw; it is my cheapest direction.

lines.zh: 沙子从壳缝里漏下去，像一场小雨。
lines.en: Sand leaks through my shell seams like a small rain.

lines.zh: 潮水退了，我先去占那块湿石头。
lines.en: The tide is out; I claim the wet stone first.

lines.zh: 八条腿一起敲，滩涂像一面小鼓。
lines.en: Eight legs drum together and the flat becomes a little drum.

lines.zh: 别拦我，我要赶在浪回来之前过去。
lines.en: Do not block me; I must cross before the wave returns.

lines.zh: 石岸太滑，我用钳尖一寸寸试探。
lines.en: The stone shore is slick; I test it claw-tip by claw-tip.

lines.zh: 红树林的根比迷宫还会绕人。
lines.en: Mangrove roots twist worse than any maze.

lines.zh: 我走的是斜线，直线留给不会躲的人。
lines.en: I take the diagonal; straight lines are for those who cannot dodge.

lines.zh: 每一步都把泥踩出小坑，正好记住路。
lines.en: Each step leaves a pit in the mud, a note for the way back.

lines.zh: 壳撞到碎石，咔一声，我就知道到家了。
lines.en: My shell clicks on gravel and I know I am home.

lines.zh: 潮池之间有条缝，只有我这种宽度能钻。
lines.en: There is a gap between tide pools only my width can enter.

lines.zh: 从沼泽走到丛林边缘，我花了整晚。
lines.en: Swamp to jungle edge cost me the whole night.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边扫，谁掉的东西都是我的。
lines.en: I sweep as I walk; whatever falls belongs to me.

lines.zh: 退潮线是我的路标，浪花一碰就重画。
lines.en: The tideline is my road sign, redrawn by every ripple.

lines.zh: 我绕着潮池走，脚步是斜的。
lines.en: I walk around the tide pool at an angle.

lines.zh: 泥里陷了半步，我又拔出来。
lines.en: A half step sinks into mud, and I pull free.

lines.zh: 钳子夹着空气，练一个开壳的动作。
lines.en: My claws pinch air, rehearsing how to open a shell.

lines.zh: 我蹲在石缝里，等一个不长眼的贝。
lines.en: I squat in a crevice, waiting for a careless shellfish.

lines.zh: 壳上长了点绿，我懒得清理。
lines.en: A little green grows on my shell; I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 潮声一响，我就把眼柄转过去。
lines.en: At the sound of surf my eyestalks turn toward it.

lines.zh: 沙里的气泡说明下面有东西在喘。
lines.en: Bubbles in the sand mean something breathes beneath.

lines.zh: 我把身体埋进湿沙，只留两只眼睛。
lines.en: I bury myself in wet sand, leaving two eyes out.

lines.zh: 今天不打架，今天只晒太阳。
lines.en: No fighting today; today I only bask.

lines.zh: 一侧的腿在痒，大概是又要蜕壳了。
lines.en: One side of my legs itches; I am probably molting soon.

lines.zh: 水里漂来一片烂叶，我看了它很久。
lines.en: A rotten leaf drifts by and I watch it a long while.

lines.zh: 退潮的滩涂安静得能听见自己磨钳。
lines.en: The ebb flat is so quiet I hear my own claws grind.

lines.zh: 我把洞口修圆，顺便把沙子踢远。
lines.en: I round my burrow's mouth and kick the sand away.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水浑，浑水里没人看得见我。
lines.en: Swamp water is murky, and in murk no one sees me.

lines.zh: 有时候我只是站着，让水流替我梳壳。
lines.en: Sometimes I just stand and let the current comb my shell.

lines.zh: 涨潮前我会数一遍自己的腿，八条都在。
lines.en: Before high tide I count my legs; all eight remain.

lines.zh: 你踩到的那块石头，是我的家门口。
lines.en: The stone you stepped on is my front door.

lines.zh: 你在看我，我也在量你钳子够不够大。
lines.en: You watch me; I measure whether your claws are big enough.

lines.zh: 别蹲下来，蹲下来我就当你要抢食。
lines.en: Do not crouch; crouching reads to me as stealing food.

lines.zh: 你的鞋底沾了泥，那泥是我家的。
lines.en: Your sole is muddy, and that mud is from my home.

lines.zh: 我举起两只钳子，不是投降，是打招呼。
lines.en: I raise both claws; that is a greeting, not surrender.

lines.zh: 你身上有海腥味，刚从我的滩涂来吧。
lines.en: You smell of salt; you came from my flat, did you not?

lines.zh: 眼睛抬这么高，是为了看清你要往哪走。
lines.en: My eyes sit high so I can see where you will step.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，我只是先找好退路。
lines.en: I am not afraid of you; I am only picking my escape first.

lines.zh: 你把阴影盖过来，我就往石缝里退半寸。
lines.en: Your shadow falls and I retreat half an inch into the rocks.

lines.zh: 看久了，你会发现我一直在往侧面挪。
lines.en: Watch long enough and you will see me drifting sideways.

lines.zh: 壳裂了一道，我得赶紧找石头磨平。
lines.en: A crack in my shell; I must grind it smooth on stone.

lines.zh: 这一下让我半边腿都麻了。
lines.en: That numbed half my legs.

lines.zh: 我会退，但我记住你站的位置。
lines.en: I will retreat, but I remember where you stood.

lines.zh: 疼的时候我横着跑得比平时快。
lines.en: When it hurts I run sideways faster than usual.

lines.zh: 别打壳，里面的肉会跟着震。
lines.en: Do not strike the shell; the meat inside shakes with it.

lines.zh: 我吐了两个气泡，这已经是示弱了。
lines.en: I release two bubbles; that is already a surrender.

lines.zh: 石缝就在三步外，我数着爬过去。
lines.en: The crevice is three steps away; I count my way there.

lines.zh: 这一下够我记到下次蜕壳。
lines.en: This one will stay with me until my next molt.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，用厚的那面壳对着你。
lines.en: I turn my thick shell toward you.

lines.zh: 你们总是先打钳子，可惜钳子最不怕打。
lines.en: You always strike the claws first; the claws mind it least.

lines.zh: 你手里那点腥味，隔着沙子都冲我。
lines.en: That fishy smell in your hand reaches me through the sand.

lines.zh: 我不贪，我只想要你掉在地上的那半块。
lines.en: I am not greedy; I only want the half you dropped.

lines.zh: 你再晃一下，我的钳子就不听使唤了。
lines.en: Shake it once more and my claws stop obeying me.

lines.zh: 腐肉也行，烂鱼也行，我不挑。
lines.en: Rotten flesh or spoiled fish, I am not picky.

lines.zh: 我把身体压低，慢慢靠近，你别急着收手。
lines.en: I lower myself and creep closer; do not pull your hand back.

lines.zh: 这味道让我想起退潮后留下的那顿晚餐。
lines.en: That smell recalls the dinner the ebb tide left behind.

lines.zh: 给我一口，我就让你摸一下壳。
lines.en: One bite and I will let you touch my shell.

lines.zh: 我在算距离，从你的手指到我的钳口。
lines.en: I am measuring the distance from your fingers to my claws.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我就进一步，这是滩涂的规矩。
lines.en: You step back, I step forward; that is the flat's rule.

lines.zh: 我钳住了就不松，哪怕你把我提起来。
lines.en: Once I pinch I do not let go, even if you lift me.

lines.zh: 撞我一下，我壳上的藤壶都响了。
lines.en: Bump me and the barnacles on my shell rattle.

lines.zh: 你脚太大了，整条退路都被你堵住。
lines.en: Your foot is huge; you have blocked my whole retreat.

lines.zh: 我横着让开，你却往前一步，真不讲理。
lines.en: I sidestep; you step forward. How rude.

lines.zh: 这一下把我推得翻了个身，我自己会翻回来。
lines.en: That flipped me over; I will right myself.

lines.zh: 别踩我的钳子，那是我吃饭的家伙。
lines.en: Do not step on my claws; they are how I eat.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起时，你比石头软多了。
lines.en: When we collide you are much softer than stone.

lines.zh: 我退到石缝里，把壳卡住，你就推不动了。
lines.en: I wedge my shell in a crevice and you cannot push me.

lines.zh: 沼泽的泥太滑，我一撞就滑出半米。
lines.en: Swamp mud is slick; one bump slides me half a meter.

lines.zh: 这不是攻击，这只是我路过你。
lines.en: This is not an attack; I am merely passing through you.

lines.zh: 你挡住潮水，我就绕着你走一圈。
lines.en: If you block the current I will walk a circle around you.

lines.zh: 我在洞口敲壳，敲三下就是请她进来。
lines.en: I tap my shell at the burrow, three knocks, an invitation.

lines.zh: 她的钳子比我的小一圈，正好合得上。
lines.en: Her claws are a size smaller than mine, and they fit.

lines.zh: 求偶的时候我不横着走，我正面站直。
lines.en: In courtship I do not walk sideways; I stand square.

lines.zh: 我举起钳子又放下，反复好几次。
lines.en: I lift my claws and lower them, over and over.

lines.zh: 她要是转身，我就跟着挪半米再试。
lines.en: If she turns away I shift half a meter and try again.

lines.zh: 我们并排挖洞，沙子朝同一个方向飞。
lines.en: We dig side by side, sand flying the same way.

lines.zh: 这段日子我不打架，连贝壳都让给她。
lines.en: These days I do not fight; I even yield the shells.

lines.zh: 潮水会把我们的洞冲平，我们会再挖。
lines.en: The tide will flatten our burrow; we will dig again.

lines.zh: 她碰一下我的钳，我就知道成了。
lines.en: She taps my claw once and I know it is settled.

lines.zh: 之后守洞的活归我，找食的活归她。
lines.en: After that I guard the burrow and she forages.

lines.zh: 地上有片亮东西，我先夹起来再说。
lines.en: Something bright lies there; I pinch it first, ask later.

lines.zh: 我不吃这个，但我喜欢把它搬回洞里。
lines.en: I do not eat this, but I like carrying it home.

lines.zh: 钳子太小，我试了三次才夹稳。
lines.en: My claws are small; it took three tries to hold it.

lines.zh: 掉在滩涂上的，最后都会进我的洞。
lines.en: Whatever falls on the flat ends up in my burrow.

lines.zh: 你丢的东西我收着，等你忘了就是我的。
lines.en: I keep what you drop; once you forget, it is mine.

lines.zh: 我把它压在身下，横着走回石缝。
lines.en: I tuck it beneath me and sidle back to the crevice.

lines.zh: 这玩意儿比蟹肉硬，咬不动，先囤着。
lines.en: This is harder than crab meat; I cannot bite it, so I hoard it.

lines.zh: 沼泽水一涨，我捡的东西就全漂走了。
lines.en: When the swamp rises, everything I gathered floats off.

lines.zh: 洞里已经堆了不少，我还是想再捡一个。
lines.en: My burrow is cluttered and I still want one more.

lines.zh: 夹着东西走路很别扭，但我舍不得放下。
lines.en: Walking with a load is awkward, but I will not drop it.

lines.zh: 那条鱼游得太慢，我决定是它了。
lines.en: That fish swims too slowly; I choose it.

lines.zh: 我看见贝壳缝在动，目标就在里面。
lines.en: I see a shell seam move; my target is inside.

lines.zh: 谁碰了我的洞，我就锁定谁。
lines.en: Whoever touches my burrow, I lock onto them.

lines.zh: 它比我小，这是滩涂上最省事的判断。
lines.en: It is smaller than me; on the flat that is the easiest verdict.

lines.zh: 我停下所有动作，只把眼柄对准它。
lines.en: I stop everything and point my eyestalks at it.

lines.zh: 退潮把猎物困在浅水里，我等很久了。
lines.en: The ebb trapped prey in the shallows; I waited long for this.

lines.zh: 目标定了，我就不再看别处。
lines.en: Once the target is set I look nowhere else.

lines.zh: 它想跑，可这片沙是我的地盘。
lines.en: It tries to flee, but this sand is mine.

lines.zh: 我慢慢侧移，绕到它退路的那一边。
lines.en: I sidle slowly around to the side it would flee toward.

lines.zh: 水里有血味，说明附近有更容易的猎物。
lines.en: There is blood in the water; easier prey is near.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙面走，钳子张到最大。
lines.en: I hug the sand, claws open as wide as they go.

lines.zh: 每一次它动，我就再靠近一个壳宽。
lines.en: Each time it moves I close one shell-width.

lines.zh: 我不急，急的钳子夹不稳。
lines.en: I do not rush; rushed claws grip badly.

lines.zh: 它以为石头挡住了我，其实我从侧面来。
lines.en: It thinks the rock hides me; I come from the side.

lines.zh: 我数着它的摆尾，第三下之后就是空隙。
lines.en: I count its tail beats; the gap comes after the third.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水帮我，浑水里它看不见我的钳。
lines.en: The swamp helps me; in murk it cannot see my claws.

lines.zh: 我把一只钳举高，另一只藏在沙下。
lines.en: I raise one claw and keep the other under the sand.

lines.zh: 再近一点我就扑，横向扑比直冲快。
lines.en: Closer, then I lunge; sideways is faster than straight.

lines.zh: 它闻到我了，尾巴一僵，正好。
lines.en: It smells me and its tail stiffens. Perfect.

lines.zh: 我等它先动，先动的一方总会露破绽。
lines.en: I let it move first; whoever moves first shows a gap.

lines.zh: 钳子合上的声音，比咬更让人记住。
lines.en: The sound of my claws closing is remembered longer than a bite.

lines.zh: 我夹住就不放，你越挣我越紧。
lines.en: I pinch and hold; the more you struggle the tighter I get.

lines.zh: 这一下只为让你退，不为一顿饱。
lines.en: This strike is to make you retreat, not to feed me.

lines.zh: 硬壳是我唯一的甲，钳子是我唯一的刀。
lines.en: Hard shell is my only armor; claws my only blade.

lines.zh: 我专挑软的关节，那里最好夹。
lines.en: I aim for soft joints; they pinch best.

lines.zh: 水花一炸，我的钳已经收回石缝。
lines.en: The water bursts and my claws are already back in the crevice.

lines.zh: 别把手伸进洞里，那是自找的。
lines.en: Do not reach into the burrow; that is your own doing.

lines.zh: 我一钳下去，滩涂上就多一声脆响。
lines.en: One snap and the flat gains a crisp sound.

lines.zh: 我从侧面攻击，你的正面永远空着。
lines.en: I attack from the side; your front is always open.

lines.zh: 打完了我还要吃东西，所以我不恋战。
lines.en: I still need to eat, so I do not linger in a fight.

lines.zh: 我从沙里出来，壳还是软的。
lines.en: I come out of the sand with a shell still soft.

lines.zh: 这片滩涂第一次涨潮，我是被它推上来的。
lines.en: This flat's first high tide pushed me up here.

lines.zh: 兄弟姐妹五个，我们一起横着散开。
lines.en: Five of us siblings scatter sideways together.

lines.zh: 红树林的根在头顶，我学会的第一件事是躲。
lines.en: Mangrove roots overhead; the first thing I learned was hiding.

lines.zh: 沙粒扎脚，但比卵壳里宽敞太多。
lines.en: Sand pricks my feet, but it is far roomier than the egg.

lines.zh: 我一落地就找石头，没石头就没有家。
lines.en: I look for stone at once; no stone, no home.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水是温的，我在这里长第一层壳。
lines.en: Swamp water is warm; here I grow my first shell.

lines.zh: 我出生时钳子只有针尖那么大。
lines.en: When I was born my claws were the size of needle tips.

lines.zh: 潮水把我从深海带到浅处，我就留下了。
lines.en: The tide carried me from deep water to the shallows; I stayed.

lines.zh: 丛林边上的水潭里也能活，我不挑地方。
lines.en: Even a jungle pool suits me; I am not fussy.

lines.zh: 火烤过来，我的壳像锅底一样响。
lines.en: Fire comes and my shell rings like a pan bottom.

lines.zh: 从石岸摔下来，壳先着地，腿后着地。
lines.en: Off the stone shore I land shell first, legs after.

lines.zh: 我明明住在水边，却也有被水闷住的时候。
lines.en: I live by water and still can be smothered by it.

lines.zh: 一炸，我的洞就塌了，家比壳先碎。
lines.en: One blast and my burrow collapses; home breaks before shell.

lines.zh: 那根箭钉进壳缝，我带着它横着跑。
lines.en: The arrow lodged in a shell seam; I run sideways with it.

lines.zh: 紫色的东西钻进壳里，我腿一下子软了。
lines.en: Something purple seeps into my shell and my legs go slack.

lines.zh: 滩涂空了三天，我只能啃自己的壳缘。
lines.en: The flat has been empty three days; I gnaw my own shell rim.

lines.zh: 雷打在滩涂上，我整只都被掀进浅水。
lines.en: Lightning hits the flat and flings me into the shallows.

lines.zh: 底下没有沙，没有潮，只剩下落。
lines.en: Below is no sand, no tide, only falling.
